name: Mind the Offline Provider
tagline: Filter out offline payment providers before checking fees.
brief: Route payments to Provider B because Provider A is offline.
context: Provider A has a cheaper fee listed, but it is currently offline. Provider B is online.
narrative:
The starter rule attempts to route every transaction to Provider A because its fee is lower. However, Provider A is currently offline, so every attempt fails!

A low fee is useless if the provider is offline. Verify provider availability first: route transactions to Provider B while Provider B is online.
objective: Process every payment with no failures and avoid the offline provider.
learningObjective: Check availability constraints (onlineB) before evaluating price or fees.
intelligenceExplanation:
The provider status shows Provider A as offline. The naive rule `WHEN hasTransaction -> DO route-a` fails.

Change the rule to: WHEN onlineB -> DO route-b to bypass the offline provider cleanly.
hint: Change the rule to: WHEN onlineB -> DO route-b.
hints: Check provider status: Provider A is offline.
Routing to an offline provider causes immediate failures.
Use WHEN onlineB -> DO route-b to send payments to the active provider.
